body:
**Adversarial review — revision 6 (REJECTED)**

Rev 5 findings fixed: §3.5 now uses "whenever the plan file is written" for both arch_designer and arch_planner, AC 5 verifies status:draft on revision, new AC for breakdown revision, §3.3 gains revision-after-rejection paragraph. All confirmed in diff. ✓

**Two significant issues remain — both about implementation plans being left behind while designs and breakdowns got fixed.**

The rev 5 core finding was "revision-after-rejection is underspecified." Rev 6 correctly fixed this for designs (§3.5, AC 5) and breakdowns (§3.3, §3.5, new AC). But implementation plans have the **exact same class of gap** — they were not touched by the rev 6 fixes. Additionally, two parent-status-update behaviors from §3.5 are missing from the step-by-step workflows in §3.3/§3.4 that hat implementers will follow.

See inline comments for specifics.

comments.body:
**(Significant) Implementation plan revision after code-review rejection is completely unspecified.**

Rev 6 added a "Revision after rejection" paragraph to §3.3 (breakdowns, line 232) and changed §3.5 arch_designer/arch_planner to say "whenever the plan file is written (initial creation or revision after rejection)." But §3.4 has NO equivalent revision paragraph, and §3.5 dev_implementer row (line 309) still says just "Sets `status: in-progress`" — missing the "whenever written" qualifier.

When a story is rejected at `dev:code-review` and returns to `dev:implement`:
- Does the implementer overwrite the existing impl plan? (§3.4 is silent)
- Does `revision` increment? (No AC covers this)
- What status does it get? Impl plans skip draft/in-review per §2.3 line 121 — do they stay at `in-progress`?

This is the **exact same class of underspecification** that was the core finding in rev 5, but only designs and breakdowns got the fix. Implementation plans were left with the identical gap.

**Fix:** Add a "Revision after rejection" paragraph to §3.4 (parallel to §3.3 line 232), update §3.5 dev_implementer row with "whenever the plan file is written" qualifier, and add an AC for impl plan revision semantics.

**(Significant) Parent-status-update behaviors from §3.5 are absent from the step-by-step workflows.**

§3.5 arch_planner row says: "Also updates the parent design's frontmatter to `status: in-progress` when starting breakdown work." But this 5-step workflow has no such step — step 1 says "Read the design doc" with no mention of updating its status.

Same gap in §3.4: §3.5 dev_implementer row says "Also updates the parent breakdown's frontmatter to `status: in-progress` when starting story work" but the 3-step workflow (lines 264-267) has no such step.

A hat implementer following these workflows as their build guide would miss both parent-status-update behaviors entirely. AC 8 and AC 10 verify these behaviors exist, but the workflows that define HOW the hats execute don't include them.

**Fix:** Add a step to each workflow:
- §3.3 step 1: "Read the design doc from `designs/epic-<N>.md` and update its frontmatter to `status: in-progress`"
- §3.4 step 1: "Read the story issue and its parent epic's breakdown; update the breakdown's frontmatter to `status: in-progress`"
